integrity: The recent dimension-five greedy-weight article was inspected across its complete 21-page text for the projective formulation, bounds, constructions, examples, and conclusion. The lower bound is a symbolic consequence of binary projective-line geometry and rank five. The length-eleven witness is independently replayed by exact enumeration of all projective lines and all message subspaces.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats binary dimension-five codes and the CEZ bottom-up fourth greedy weight only. The sharp witness has \(d_1=1\); no claim is made about the first strict gap under a positive lower bound on minimum distance, over larger fields, or for other greedy indices. The result gives the exact minimum length but not a classification of all sharp codes.
title: The first binary five-dimensional strict fourth-greedy gap occurs at length eleven
